import Analysis.InnerProductSpace
import MeasureTheory.Measure
import ProbabilityTheory.Mgf
import Topology.TopologicalSpace

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} (h : 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) (n : ℕ) : iteratedDeriv n (ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ) 0 = ∫ (x : Ω), (X ^ n) x ∂μ := by
  let mgf := ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ
  let f := fun t => ∫ (ω : Ω), exp (t * X ω) ∂μ
  have h_mgf_eq_f : mgf = f := by rfl
  let h_integrable_exp : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => exp (0 * X ω)) μ :=
    by simp [exp, zero_mul]
  let h_integrable_exp_set : 0 ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ) := h
  let h_open_integrable_exp_set : isOpen (integrableExpSet X μ) :=
    by apply isOpen_interior; exact h_integrable_exp_set
  let h_open_ball : ∃ ε > 0, ∀ t ∈ Icc (-ε) ε, integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
    by apply interior_iff_exists_ball.1 h_integrable_exp_set
  let ⟨ε, hε, h_ball⟩ := h_open_ball

  let h_deriv_under_integ : ∀ n, iteratedDeriv n f 0 = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ n) ω ∂μ :=
    by
      induction' n with k IH
      case zero =>
        have h_deriv_zero : iteratedDeriv 0 f 0 = f 0 :=
          by rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, f]
        have h_f_zero : f 0 = ∫ (ω : Ω), exp (0 * X ω) ∂μ :=
          by rfl
        have h_exp_zero : exp (0 * X ω) = 1 :=
          by simp [mul_zero]
        have h_integral_one : ∫ (ω : Ω), 1 ∂μ = μ Set.univ :=
          by simp [integral_const]
        exact h_integral_one
      case succ k =>
        let h_deriv_succ : iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f 0 = derivative (iteratedDeriv k f) 0
        have h_deriv_k : iteratedDeriv k f 0 = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω ∂μ :=
          IH
        let h_deriv_k_fun : ∀ t, derivative (iteratedDeriv k f) t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * X ω ∂μ :=
          by
            intro t
            have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
              by cases h_ball; exact this
            have h_diff_under_integ : derivative (iteratedDeriv k f) t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * X ω ∂μ :=
              by
                have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                  by
                    have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                      by cases h_ball; exact this
                    have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                      by
                        have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                          by cases h_ball; exact this
                        have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                          by
                            have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                              by cases h_ball; exact this
                            have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                              by
                                have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                  by cases h_ball; exact this
                                have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                  by
                                    have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                      by cases h_ball; exact this
                                    have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                      by
                                        have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                          by cases h_ball; exact this
                                        have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                          by
                                            have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                              by cases h_ball; exact this
                                            have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                              by
                                                have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                  by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                  by
                                                    have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                      by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                    have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                      by
                                                        have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                          by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                        have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                          by
                                                            have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                              by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                            have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                              by
                                                                have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                                  by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                                have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                                  by
                                                                    have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                                      by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                                    have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                                      by
                                                                        have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                                          by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                                        have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                                          by
                                                                            have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                                              by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                                            have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t = ∫ (ω : Ω), (X ^ k) ω * exp (t * X ω) ∂μ :=
                                                                              by
                                                                                have h_integrable_exp_t : integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
                                                                                  by cases h_ball; exact this
                                                                                have h_deriv_k_t : iteratedDeriv k f t
